facts.statement: Free Realms celebrated its 2nd birthday on 28 April, with a special webcast starting a little earlier as the kickoff to the party.
facts.quote: celebra su 2 º cumpleaños este 28 de abril

facts.statement: The anniversary webcast was to discuss favorite moments since the game's launch and feature a couple of special guests.
facts.quote: una discusión sobre algunos de nuestros momentos favoritos desde el lanzamiento del juego

facts.statement: The webcast was scheduled as stated in the text for Thursday 2 April 2011 at 4:00 pm US Pacific time, lasting about 20 minutes, broadcast live on the SOE channel on Stickam.
facts.quote: el jueves, 2 de abril 2011, a las 4:00 pm hora del Pacífico EE.UU.

facts.statement: The webcast could also be watched through a Stickam tab on Free Realms' Facebook page, and viewers could chat by text on Stickam.
facts.quote: También puedes sintonizar a través de la ficha Stickam en nuestra página de Facebook

facts.statement: Free Realms celebrated its 2nd anniversary on 28 April with a special webcast held a little earlier, on a Thursday at 4:00 pm US Pacific time, broadcast live on the SOE channel on Stickam.
facts.quote: celebra su 2 º cumpleaños este 28 de abril, ¡pero estamos dando inicio a la fiesta un poco más temprano con una webcast especial!

facts.statement: The webcast was planned to discuss some of the team's favorite moments since the game's launch and to feature a couple of special guests.
facts.quote: La webcast incluirá una discusión sobre algunos de nuestros momentos favoritos desde el lanzamiento del juego

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: This Spanish-language SOE news post announces a special webcast for Free Realms' second anniversary (launch birthday on 28 April). The webcast was to be streamed live on SOE's Stickam channel for about 20 minutes, with viewers able to chat by text. The post's date and the webcast date are internally inconsistent in the text, so treat the webcast date as uncertain.

article_summaries.title: Fiesta de cumpleaños de Free Realms y Webcast (page title: Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: SOE's Spanish-language post announces a Free Realms 2nd anniversary celebration (the game's 2nd birthday, 28 April) with a special webcast on the SOE channel on Stickam. The webcast was to discuss favorite moments since launch and feature special guests. The post gives no in-game content, rewards or mechanics.
